scope: Theorem 3.1 (Raw supersaturation) of the manuscript “A counterexample to Hadwiger's conjecture” (preprints/A-counterexample-to-Hadwigers-conjecture-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 157 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 a97293542586d351), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 12. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the construction parameters specified in Section 2 and Appendix A, for all sufficiently large n, every probability law σ on units satisfying σ1 ≤ Mµ, σ2 ≤ Mµ, σ ≤ 2DN µ2 (3.1) has the following property: two independent units drawn from σ have all four cross holes with probability at least 2−100gN . The inequalities in Equation (3.1) are pointwise inequalities of measures on the finite raw spaces.
